title: Ikholwa Eligqunywe Ngesigqubuthelo Enkundleni Yomtyholi
intro: Ngaphakathi kweeholo zegolide zomlawuli onekratshi owaziwa yiQuran — apho ukungathobeli uThixo kwakuthetha khona yonke imithetho — umphefumlo omnye wawuhamba phakathi kwabantu abanelungelo, ufihla iimfihlo eziyingozi kakhulu emehlweni. Lo mntu wayephethe ukholo olwalungavumelekanga ngaphakathi kwezo ndonga kangangokuba ukufunyanwa kwalo kwakuthetha ukufa okuqinisekileyo. Kodwa ukugweba kwavutha njengelangatye phantsi kothuthu, kwaye xa ixesha lifika, inyaniso yavakala ngenkalipho eyashukumisa isiseko sebhotwe lomchasi.
clues: Bendihlala phakathi kwesangqa somlawuli onamandla nozikhukhumezayo wexesha lam, ndijikelezwe bubunewunewu nempembelelo.
Ndayifihla inkolelo yam yokwenene ngaphakathi entliziyweni yam, ndisoyikela ubomi bam kwabo babelawula ngenkohlakalo nangokucinezelwa.
Xa abantu bam babethandabuza baze bathandabuze inyaniso, ndaya phambili ukuze ndibalumkise ngeshwangusha elibi elawehlela iintlanga zangaphambili ezazingazamkeli izithunywa zeNkosi yazo.
Ndibakhumbuze abantu bakuthi ngebali lomphupha oselula othandekayo owaphoswa phantsi zizihlobo zakhe kodwa waphakama waba negunya elikhulu kwilizwe elikude.
Ndibacelile abantu bam ukuba bangamthobeli umlawuli obalahlekisileyo, endaweni yoko ndibamema ukuba bandilandele endleleni yobulungisa nesikhokelo.
Ndithethe inyaniso ngokukhululekileyo nangona abalandeli bombusi babendisongela ngokundixuluba ngamatye okanye ukundigxotha kweli lizwe.
